explanation: Melville named the ship after the Pequot people of New England. Its first mate, Starbuck, gave his name to a coffee chain whose founders had first considered calling it Pequod.

claims.text: In Moby-Dick, Captain Ahab's whaling ship is the Pequod.
The Hispaniola (Treasure Island), the Nautilus (Jules Verne) and the Dawn Treader (Narnia) are ships from other books.
Melville named the Pequod after the Pequot people of southern New England.
The coffee company Starbucks is named after Starbuck, the first mate of the Pequod.
The founders of Starbucks first considered naming the company Pequod.
